title: Transporter's 11-year livestock smuggling run ends at border
summary: TUMPAT: A 31-year-old transporter who has spent 11 years ferrying livestock believed to have been smuggled from Thailand to various destinations nationwide was arrested today while transporting seven deer to Terengganu.
